target: Hito del Paso de las Lajas entre Hoshai y Korven.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Sucesión de terrazas naturales y peldaños antiguos reutilizados por viajeros; el origen exacto debe permanecer ambiguo.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide travel scene of Las Escaleras Rotas. A steep sequence of irregular natural terraces is interrupted by a limited number of very old worn stone steps reused by travelers. The route descends from open Hoshai rock toward increasingly fragmented Korven terrain. Make the old steps practical, incomplete and subordinate to geology, with no clue to who made them. Cold wind, gray layered rock and sparse highland scrub.
negative_constraints: No temple, ruins, statues, inscriptions or invented civilization
Do not imply a definitive origin for the old steps
No magical glow or monumental fantasy architecture
No characters or creatures as focal subject
canon_sources: vintage-telnet/REGIONAL_CONNECTIONS.md — Paso de las Lajas / Las Escaleras Rotas
notes: Fiel al anclaje geográfico canónico. No definir interior, jefe, secreto ni mecánica.
